coil.name: START_SYSTEM
coil.description: Write 1 into this coil to initialize the system, otherwise disable the system

coil.name: ENABLE_DISPENSING_1
coil.description: Write 1 into the coil to enable dispensing of Pump and Solenoid A, otherwise disable them

coil.name: ENABLE_DISPENSING_2
coil.description: Write 1 into the coil to enable dispensing of Pump and Solenoid B, otherwise disable them

coil.name: REFILL_ONGOING
coil.description: Write 1 into this coil to indicate the operator has pressed the refill button

coil.name: RESET
coil.description: Write this coil from 0 to 1 will reset the safety triggered state of the system

coil.name: WATCHDOG
coil.description: Toggle to reset the compound system's watchdog timer. Activate (set to true) for 20ms, then deactivate (set to false) to reset.

coil.name: ENABLE_OVERPRESSURE_PURGE_1
coil.description: Enable the embedded PLC function to purge the nozzle A until the pressure drops to the normal working level

coil.name: ENABLE_OVERPRESSURE_PURGE_2
coil.description: Enable the embedded PLC function to purge the nozzle B until the pressure drops to the normal working level

coil.name: ENABLE_PUMPHEAD_PURGE_1
coil.description: Enable the embedded PLC function to purge the nozzle A until the pressure drops to zero for pumphead replacement

coil.name: ENABLE_PUMPHEAD_PURGE_2
coil.description: Enable the embedded PLC function to purge the nozzle B until the pressure drops to zero for pumphead replacement

register.name: MAX_COMPOUND_SENSOR_DISTANCE_1

register.name: DESIRED_COMPOUND_PRESSURE
register.description: Then desired compound pressure during dispensing

register.name: DESIRED_COMPOUND_FLOW_1
register.description: The desired dispensing flow speed for compound system A

register.name: MAX_COMPOUND_SENSOR_DISTANCE_2
register.description: The maximum distance from ultrasonic sensor to the compound surface for the system B to allow dispensing

register.name: DESIRED_COMPOUND_FLOW_2
register.description: The desired dispensing flow speed for compound system B

register.name: COMPOUND_SYSTEM_ERROR_1

register.name: COMPOUND_SYSTEM_STATE_1

register.decription: The maximum allowable pressure for system A. Pressures exceeding this limit are deemed hazardous.

register.name: COMPOUND_SYSTEM_MAX_PRESSURE_LIMIT_2

register.name: COMPOUND_SYSTEM_PURGE_TARGET_PRESSURE_2
